page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m2.large is an entry-tier virtual machine configuration belonging to the shared-core instance family. Built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 CPU architecture, it features 2 shared vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. It includes no bundled local storage or dedicated graphics processing units, operating purely as a diskless compute node relying on remote block storage.

Because the processor allocation is shared among tenants, resource access relies on host-level virtualization scheduling rather than dedicated physical cores. This architecture makes the instance economically positioned for non-continuous, low-concurrency execution profiles where sustained full-core utilization is not mandatory. The zero baseline allocation for network bandwidth and public IPv4 addresses also reflects an infrastructure component intended for internal routing, lightweight staging, or background tasks.

Given its hardware profile and shared core model, ecs.s6-c1m2.large serves low-traffic web hosting, microservices, testing environments, continuous integration agents, and standard utility workloads with modest memory footprints.
